name: Facets Range Input
description: Adds a min/max range-input widget and companion processor to the Facets module, letting visitors filter a numeric facet by entering a lower and upper bound instead of picking discrete values.
project_description: Facets Range Input extends the Facets module with a range-input widget (plugin id 'range_input', class RangeInputWidget) and a matching facets processor (plugin id 'range_input', class RangeInputProcessor) so a numeric facet can be filtered by a min/max range rather than a list of discrete values. The widget renders a small AJAX form (RangeInputForm, form id 'facets_range_input_form') with two HTML5 number fields (minimum/maximum), configurable titles and placeholders stored under the facet's widget config (schema facet.widget.config.range_input). The widget declares query type 'range' so filtering is delegated to the Facets range query type. The processor's build stage rewrites each result URL to carry the placeholder token '(min:__range_input_min__,max:__range_input_max__)' via the facets URL generator; range-input.js (behavior Drupal.behaviors.rangeInput plus the jQuery facetsRangeInputFilter helper) substitutes the visitor's numeric values into that URL and triggers a Facets AJAX refresh. The processor's preQuery stage parses the active item back with the regex /\(min:((?:-)?[\d\.]+),max:((?:-)?[\d\.]+)\)/i (numeric-only) and postQuery synthesises Result objects for every integer step between the discovered min and max. hook_theme (ThemeHooks) registers the two Twig templates facets-range-input.html.twig and facets-range-input-form.html.twig. The module owns no routes, permissions, controllers, entities or Drush commands; its only config is the per-widget schema.
